# Temple Scroll Column 6 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Temple Scroll Column 6 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 6:1 — "Festival of Weeks" naming

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-Festival of-Weeks" | Literal with hyphenation |
| LOGOS | "the Festival of Weeks" | Standard formal rendering of chag ha-shavu'ot |
| PNEUMA | "the Harvest Festival" | Dynamic functional equivalent for modern readers |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering "the Festival of Weeks." This is the established English term. PNEUMA's "Harvest Festival" imports a meaning not explicit in the Hebrew name and could confuse readers familiar with biblical terminology.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 6:6 — "tirosh" — new wine terminology

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "new wine" | Standard rendering of tirosh |
| LOGOS | "new wine" | Same standard rendering |
| PNEUMA | "freshly pressed wine" | Explanatory rendering emphasizing the fresh character of tirosh |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS/EMET rendering "new wine." This is the established translation of tirosh in all major English versions. PNEUMA's "freshly pressed" adds specificity not in the text.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/EMET.

---

## 6:9 — "benei Yisra'el" — sons of Israel vs. people of Israel

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-sons-of-Israel" | Literal rendering of benei |
| LOGOS | "the sons of Israel" | Standard formal rendering |
| PNEUMA | "all the people of Israel" | Dynamic rendering; "people" for benei; adds "all" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering "the sons of Israel." In this hierarchical context (priests, Levites, sons of Israel), the literal "sons" preserves the kinship/tribal language that is functionally important. PNEUMA's "people" and added "all" are both departures.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 6:11 — "chuqqat 'olam" — statute phrasing (recurring)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a-statute of-eternity for-your-generations in-all your-dwelling-places" | Full hyphenated construct chain |
| LOGOS | "an everlasting statute throughout your generations, in all your dwelling places" | Standard formal rendering with commas |
| PNEUMA | "a permanent law for all generations, wherever you live" | Dynamic rendering with modern phrasing |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering. Consistent with Column 1 precedent for chuqqat 'olam. PNEUMA's "wherever you live" is too colloquial for legislative text.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements: 4*
*Resolution: LOGOS 3, LOGOS/EMET 1, EMET 0, PNEUMA 0, Compromise 0*
